sentences.text: THESE MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEALS, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY, UMESH M. ADIGA, J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Claimant in M.V.C.No.1251/2019 on the file of the II Additional Senior Civil Judge and M.A.C.T-7,
Vijayapura (for short, "Tribunal") has filed appeal in M.F.A.No.201472/2022 claiming for enhancement of compensation and the Insurer/Respondent No.2 has filed NC:
2023:KHC-K:5691-DB appeal in M.F.A.No.202405/2022 challenging its liability and also quantum of compensation.
2. Both these appeals taken up together for final disposal.
3.
Brief facts of the case of claimants are that on 07.06.2019, deceased Kumar met with an accident due to rash and negligent driving of Mahindra Scorpio bearing Rg.No.KA-33/M-6307 by its driver.

The Branch Manager vs Kasturabai And Anr on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17229650/

sentences.text: He sustained fatal injuries and succumbed to injury.
It is further contended that deceased was aged about 19 years and earning Rs.15,000/- per month by working as a Coolie and contributing to the family.
Claimant being mother of the deceased was depending upon his earnings.

With these reasons, prayed to award compensation of Rs.34,50,000/-.
4.
The contention of Respondent No.1/Owner is that the said vehicle was insured with the second respondent and accident was not caused due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the vehicle.
Therefore, prayed to reject the claim petition.
The Respondent No.2/Insurer has also denied contents of the petition.

It is further contended that death of Kumar was caused by some other reason and with an intention to claim compensation,
false case was filed by implicating the said vehicle.
The driver of the said vehicle had no valid and effective driving license to drive the vehicle.
With the said reasons, it prayed to dismiss the petition.
6. From the rival contentions of the parties, the Tribunal had framed necessary issues.
7. The claimant examined PWs-1 and 2 and got marked Exs.P1 to P7.

The respondents examined RWs-1 and 2 and got marked Exs.R1 to R3.
8.

The Tribunal, after hearing both the parties and on appreciating pleadings and evidence on record, by the impugned judgment partly allowed the petitions, awarded following compensation:
NC: 2023:KHC-K:5691-DB Sl.No. Particulars Amount (Rs.)
1. Loss of income due to 21,46,392 dependency 2. Loss of estate 15,000 3.
Towards transportation and 15,000 funeral expenses 4.
Towards loss of consortium 40,000 5.
Medical expenses -Nil- Total 22,16,392 9.
The learned advocate for the Insurer has submitted that without any basis, the Tribunal has taken income of the deceased as Rs.13,500/-.
He has not died due to the vehicle accident.
On the contrary, he was working in Mines and while blasting the stone, he sustained injuries and died.
However, for wrongful gain, in collusion with police, falsely implicated the said vehicle, which was driving by husband of claimant at the time of the accident.

sentences.text: He has further submitted that the Tribunal has taken future prospects at the rate of 50%, which is not permissible since deceased was not a Government servant or having fixed salary.
The driver of the said vehicle had no valid and effective driving license.
The name of the driver is mentioned as Govind Nayak, Son of Neelappa.
However, as NC: 2023:KHC-K:5691-DB per the case of the prosecution and police report, name of the driver was Anil @ Govind, Son of Nilanayak Chauhan.
It indicates that the driver had no valid and effective driving license.

Under these circumstances,
Respondent No.2 is not liable to indemnify and prayed to dismiss the petition against Respondent No.2/Insuer.
11.
The learned advocate for the owner has submitted that name of the driver of the vehicle is Anil @ Govind, Son of Nilanayak.
In the charge-sheet, his name is properly mentioned as Anil @ Govind, Son of Nilanayak.
Copy of the driving license is produced at Ex.R1.
It shows his name as Govind Nayak, Son of Neelappa.
However, it was omitted to mention his name as Anil @ Govind Nayak.
Ex.R1 also shows photo of holder of the said license.
Without any basis, the Insurer has been contending that driving license produced at Ex.R1 does not belong to driver of the offended vehicle, which is not tenable.

12. The contention of the Insurer that the death of Kumar, son of Anil Chauhan was caused in the stone blast was considered by the Tribunal and in Issue No.1, the NC: 2023:KHC-K:5691-DB Tribunal has discussed in this regard in detail and rightly held that the death was caused due to vehicle accident.
The evidence given by RW-1 is not on the basis of any materials.
The criminal case was registered for the accident in question, which indicates that accident was taken place due to the negligent driving of the vehicle by its driver.
The post- mortem-Ex.P4 indicates that deceased had sustained severe head injury and minor abrasion on other part of the body.
The medical officer opined that death was due to hemorrhage and shock, as a result of injury to the brain.
Had he died due to blast in the stone quarry, then, there would be several injuries on the other parts of the body and nature of injuries would be different.
Therefore, the contention of the Insurer that death of Kumar was caused due to blast in the stone quarry is not supported by any materials.

13. It appears the Insurer is contending on the basis of incorrectly mentioning the name of driver in the cahrge- sheet and driving license and contending that driver of the said vehicle had no valid and effective driving license.
The NC: 2023:KHC-K:5691-DB license produced at Ex.R1 belong to one Govind Nayak, Son of Neelappa.
In Ex.P7, name of the accused is mentioned as Anil @ Govind, Son of Nilanayak Chauhan.
In Ex.R1, his name is mentioned as Govind Nayak, Son of Neelappa.
It appears, name of the accused or driver of the vehicle is not completely stated in the Driving License.
His name appears to be Anil @ Govind.
As rightly submitted by the learned advocate for the owner of the vehicle, Ex.R1 shows the photo of the driver of the vehicle.
RW-2 in his evidence has not brought out any materials to show that Ex.R1 does not belong to accused in the criminal case.
The owner of the vehicle was examined as RW-1 and in his evidence, he has stated that name of the driver was Anil @ Govind Nayak, Son of Neelappa.
However, in this driving license, his complete name as "Anil @ Govind Nayak", Son of Neelappa is missing and only "Govind Nayak" is mentioned.
He was not cross- examined by the Insurer.
Hence, the contention of the Insurer is not tenable.

sentences.text: The Tribunal, while assessing the compensation has rightly taken the income of the deceased as Rs.13,250/-.
The Tribunal has added 50% of income towards future prospects.
Admittedly, deceased had no fixed salary.
Therefore, as per the law rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED VS. PRANAY SETHI AND OTHERS1, 40% of income must be added towards future prospects.

entities.text: NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED VS. PRANAY SETHI AND OTHERS1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Deceased was un- married and hence, 50% of his earnings has to be deducted towards his personal expenses.
Admittedly, the multiplier applicable in the present case is '18'.
Therefore, claimant is entitled for compensation under the head 'loss of dependency' is Rs.9,275X12X18 = Rs.20,03,400/-.

The computation of compensation is as under:
Monthly income Rs.13,250 of the deceased Add 40% of future prospects Rs.5300 Rs.18,550 Deduct 50% of personal expenses Rs.9,275 9275X12X18 (multiplier)
TOTAL 20,03,400 1 2017 ACJ 2700 - 11 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:5691-DB 16.
The compensation awarded by the Tribunal on all other heads are just and reasonable and does not call for any interference.

17. For the aforesaid discussion, we pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal in M.F.A.No.201472 of 2022 is dismissed.
ii) The appeal in M.F.A.No.202405 of 2022 is partly allowed.
iii) The impugned judgment and award passed by the II Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Vijayapura in M.V.C.No.1251/2019 dated 20.05.2022 is modified as under..
